children: Read Rory P, a direct shareholder and President & CEO, reported a sale of Class A Common Stock on 2026-09-16. The shares were sold at a weighted average price of $5.55 per share. The total sale amount reported was $809,550. Following the transaction, the reporting person directly owns 3,273,325 Class A Common Stock. The filing states the sale represented shares sold to cover statutory tax withholding obligations in connection with RSU vesting and was not a discretionary sale.
